<section id="guidelines" class="list-section">
## Guidelines and reference documents

<p>Official links updated for the course. For the European Union, EUR-Lex is used whenever possible instead of old Commission PDF locations.</p>

<div class="guide-grid">
<article class="guide-card"><h3>Market definition</h3>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill eu">EU</span><span class="pill current">2024</span><a href="https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/C/2024/1645/oj/eng">Market Definition Notice</a><small>Commission Notice C/2024/1645; replaces the 1997 notice.</small></div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill uk">UK</span><span class="pill legacy">legacy</span><a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/market-definition">Market definition — OFT403</a><small>Adopted by the CMA, but the 2004 text remains unamended.</small></div>
</article>

<article class="guide-card"><h3>Market power and dominance</h3>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill eu">EU</span><span class="pill current">current</span><a href="https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/ES/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A52009XC0224%2801%29">Article 102 enforcement priorities</a><small>2009 Guidance, read together with the 2023 amendments.</small></div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill eu">EU</span><span class="pill current">2023</span><a href="https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/ES/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A52023XC0331%2801%29">Amendments to the Article 102 Guidance</a><small>Updated enforcement priorities.</small></div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill uk">UK</span><span class="pill legacy">legacy</span><a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/assessment-of-market-power">Assessment of market power — OFT415</a><small>Adopted by the CMA; original 2004 text.</small></div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill uk">UK</span><span class="pill legacy">legacy</span><a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/abuse-of-a-dominant-position">Abuse of a dominant position — OFT402</a><small>Adopted by the CMA; original 2004 text.</small></div>
</article>

<article class="guide-card"><h3>Horizontal agreements</h3>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill eu">EU</span><span class="pill current">2023</span><a href="https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/ES/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A52023XC0721%2801%29">Horizontal Cooperation Guidelines</a><small>2023/C 259/01; replace the 2011 guidelines.</small></div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill uk">UK</span><span class="pill current">2023</span><a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/guidance-on-horizontal-agreements">Horizontal agreements — CMA184</a><small>Current CMA guidance.</small></div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill us">US</span><span class="pill draft">status</span><a href="https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2026/02/federal-trade-commission-department-justice-seek-public-comment-guidance-business-collaborations">Competitor-collaboration guidance under review</a><small>The 2000 Collaboration Guidelines were withdrawn; replacement guidance was under development in 2026.</small></div>
</article>

<article class="guide-card"><h3>Vertical restraints</h3>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill eu">EU</span><span class="pill current">2022</span><a href="https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/ES/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A52022XC0630%2801%29">Guidelines on Vertical Restraints</a><small>2022/C 248/01.</small></div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill uk">UK</span><span class="pill current">2022</span><a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/vabeo-guidance">VABEO guidance</a><small>Current CMA guidance on vertical agreements.</small></div>
</article>

<article class="guide-card wide"><h3>Mergers</h3>
<div class="card-grid two">
<div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill us">US</span><span class="pill current">2023</span><a href="https://www.ftc.gov/system/files/ftc_gov/pdf/P234000-NEW-MERGER-GUIDELINES.pdf">DOJ/FTC Merger Guidelines</a><small>Final 2023 text.</small></div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill uk">UK</span><span class="pill current">current</span><a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/merger-assessment-guidelines">Merger Assessment Guidelines — CMA129</a><small>Current substantive guidance; page updated in 2026.</small></div>
</div>
<div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill eu">EU</span><span class="pill current">2004</span><a href="https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/ES/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A52004XC0205%2802%29">Horizontal Merger Guidelines</a><small>Current text while the review continues.</small></div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill eu">EU</span><span class="pill current">2008</span><a href="https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/ES/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A52008XC1018%2803%29">Non-Horizontal Merger Guidelines</a><small>Current text while the review continues.</small></div>
<div class="guide-doc"><span class="pill eu">EU</span><span class="pill draft">2026 draft</span><a href="https://competition-policy.ec.europa.eu/mergers/review-merger-guidelines_en">Draft revised Merger Guidelines</a><small>Consultation draft; not presented as the current rule.</small></div>
</div>
</div>
</article>
</div>

<div class="teaching-note"><strong>Status note.</strong> I do not force a U.S. document into every topic when there is no general current guideline. Historical documents remain useful, but are labelled as legacy rather than presented as current guidance.</div>
</section>
